title: Canada country balance
as_of_note: Headline values are 2025 annual means from the declared spine per leg. Spine reads sit side by side and are never averaged.
units: kb/d unless a field name says otherwise

grain.capture: Facility and battery grain inside the house model (Petrinex base, AER ST3), aggregated into the WCSB balance. Agency reads are country grain.
grain.display: Country, with the WCSB house balance as the built-up frame
